## Analysis

**Critical Issue:** Complete degeneracy across all 19 folds with zero exposure (0.0/0.0). The baseline is not generating any positions. The OOS metrics are meaningless artifacts when no trades execute.

**Diagnosis:** `unified_baseline` is either a placeholder or has filters/thresholds blocking all signal generation.

## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
aub diag exposure --lane ost_v62_unified --verbose
aub param scan entry_threshold --range 0.01:0.10:0.01 --lane ost_v62_unified
aub run --lane ost_v62_unified --force-positions --validate
```
